entities.summary: Zachary Jones is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Rochester Americans of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Buffalo Sabres of the National Hockey League (NHL). Jones was drafted by the New York Rangers in the third round, 68th overall, of the 2019 NHL entry draft.
